WITH per_timespan AS (
  SELECT
    o.timespan,
    AVG(1.0 * f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS distinct_order_count
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
with_cross_group_avg AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    AVG(distinct_order_count) OVER () AS cross_group_avg_count
  FROM per_timespan
),
kept AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM with_cross_group_avg
  WHERE distinct_order_count > cross_group_avg_count
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_of_average_ratios,
  SUM(distinct_order_count) AS sum_distinct_order_counts,
  AVG(distinct_order_count - cross_group_avg_count) AS average_excess_count
FROM kept

assumptions.assumption: Each fee row contributes its rebrate/feerate ratio to its timespan’s average; NULL inputs and zero feerates yield NULL ratios, which AVG ignores. Timespans with no matched fee rows are absent.
